paragraphs.text: Emperor Mihail II is the current sovereign of Vodalia on Dominaria . He is a member of the Stovorod caste, the aristocracy of Vodalia.

Mihail served in the military in his youth. A strong leader for his merfolk kindred, he is torn between his desire to right the ills of the world and his fear of pushing a realm already teetering on the brink of autocracy over the edge. The Phyrexian invasion has only made louder the calls in Mihail's inner circle for control at any cost.

Mihail is married to Annika of the low-class Voyshe caste. Empress Annika is a former schoolteacher and a faithful but liberal Svyelunite . Their daughters are the intelligent and opinionated Princess Felisia and the quiet, thoughtful Princess Marja .
